entities.summary:
Ferdinand Eisen was an Estonian educator, pedagogy researcher and education administrator who served as Minister of Education of the Estonian Soviet Socialist Republic from April 1960 to July 1980. In Estonian education history he is noted for long tenure and for initiatives associated with maintaining an 11-year general school in Estonia within the Soviet system, expanding specialised classes, promoting Estonian-language teaching materials, and introducing a five-day school week.
